item.title: Python Methods to Identify Operating System Platform
item.description:
“Python Methods to Identify Operating System Platform”

When writing platform-agnostic Python code, reliably identifying the host operating system (OS) is crucial for conditional execution paths, accessing system-specific resources, or managing file paths. Python offers several built-in modules—primarily os, platform, and sys—each providing different levels of detail or abstraction for this task.

What are the most effective and distinct ways to programmatically ascertain whether a Python script is executing on Linux, Windows, macOS (Darwin), or within specialized environments like Jython or MSYS2?
